name: Regenerate Examples

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  SQLX_OFFLINE: "true"

jobs:
  regenerate-examples:
    name: Regenerate Examples and Run Safety Checks
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@master
        with:
          toolchain: "1.93.0"

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2

      - name: Install nextest
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@nextest

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude e2e-tests --profile ci

      - name: Run safety checks and generate examples
        run: |
          # Generate examples with safety checks
          cargo run -p tokf-cli -- verify --safety --scope stdlib --json > safety_results.json
          
          # Generate examples without safety checks for comparison
          cargo run -p tokf-cli -- verify --scope stdlib --json > no_safety_results.json
          
          # Run example generation for all filters
          cargo run -p tokf-filter --example generate_examples
          
          # Run example generation with sandboxed safety checks
          cargo run -p tokf-filter --example generate_examples_sandboxed

      - name: Verify safety checks pass
        run: |
          # Check that safety checks are enabled by default
          SAFETY_OUTPUT=$(cargo run -p tokf-cli -- verify --scope stdlib --json 2>&1)
          if echo "$SAFETY_OUTPUT" | grep -q "safety_passed"; then
            echo "Safety checks are properly included in output"
          else
            echo "ERROR: Safety checks missing from output"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Validate generated examples
        run: |
          # Check that examples.json was generated
          if [ ! -f "examples.json" ]; then
            echo "ERROR: examples.json not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          # Validate JSON structure
          python3 -c "
import json
with open('examples.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)
    print('Examples JSON valid')
    print(f'Generated {len(data)} examples')
          "

      - name: Run integration tests
        run: |
          # Run DB integration tests
          cargo nextest run --package e2e-tests --profile ci

      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: |
          # Run E2E tests
          cargo nextest run --package e2e-tests --profile ci --test-threads 1

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

      - name: Clippy
        run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

      - name: Check for code duplication
        uses: baptiste0928/cargo-install@v3
        with:
          crate: cargo-dupes

      - name: Run cargo-dupes check
        run: cargo dupes check

      - name: Check README is up-to-date
        run: bash scripts/generate-readme.sh --check

      - name: Upload examples artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: examples
          path: examples.json
          retention-days: 7
